title: ficus onusta
intro: Ficus onusta, commonly known as the Indian laurel, is a plant species native to the tropical regions of India and Southeast Asia. It is known for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Ficus onusta include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Ficus onusta include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as reducing pain, inflammation, and oxidative stress.
